result:
The app shell is implemented and verified:

- **`src/app/_layout.tsx`** — switched from tab navigation to a `Stack` (Home has no header, Health/Transcribe get header titles + automatic back navigation).
- **`src/app/index.tsx`** — Home screen: title `Native Bench`, subtitle `Token economics benchmark`, `Health`/`Transcribe` buttons that `router.push` to their screens.
- **`src/app/health.tsx`**, **`src/app/transcribe.tsx`** — new placeholder screens matching §3.2/§3.3 exactly (status lines, enabled/disabled buttons, section header, empty-state text).
- Deleted the scaffold's now-dead code: `explore.tsx`, tab components (`app-tabs.*`), and components only `explore.tsx`/the tab icon hero used (`hint-row`, `external-link`, `collapsible`, `web-badge`), plus the unused `AnimatedIcon` export (kept `AnimatedSplashOverlay`).

Verified: `npx expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild ... build` → **BUILD SUCCEEDED**, and I launched the app on the booted iOS Simulator — Home screen renders correctly with exact spec labels and no crash. (A pre-existing `tsc` error in `theme.ts`'s CSS import predates this change and is out of scope.)
